stories.title: Dobyns-Bennett High School secures fundraising so they can stay to perform in postponed Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: This year's 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed for the first time in history due to weather conditions brought by a nor'easter.

stories.title: Some East Tennessee families always make sure to go to the movies as a Thanksgiving tradition
stories.summary: Everyone has different family traditions around the holidays, but many love to go to the movies.

stories.title: Community rallies around school bus driver in Cumberland County after house burns down
stories.summary: After a fire destroyed his home and school bus, 71-year-old driver Ronald Hubbard, a beloved figure in Cumberland County, finds support from the community he loves.

stories.title: Traffic Alert: Clinton Highway closed in both directions near Stanley Road due to crash
stories.summary: KCSO said the road will be closed for an "extended period" and urges drivers to avoid the area and utilize alternate routes until further notice.

stories.title: Fundraiser launched to rebuild Clyde-Austin 4-H Center dining hall after fire
stories.summary: A fundraiser is underway to help rebuild and modernize the dining hall at the Clyde-Austin 4-H Center in Greeneville after a fire destroyed the building on Nov. 11.

stories.title: Travelers hit the roads and skies to make it to Thanksgiving dinner
stories.summary: AAA predicts more than 81 million people will travel for the holiday this year.

stories.title: South Knoxville neighbors raise money to turn old locomotive into public art
stories.summary: Island Home Park residents have raised more than $12,000 to help turn an old locomotive into a piece of public art along South Knoxville's future SoKno Rail Trail.

stories.title: 10 lawyers apply to be next Knox County Criminal Court judge
stories.summary: A commission will hear from the candidates next month and then forward recommended names to Gov. Bill Lee.

stories.title: Weigel's announces plans to open first store outside Tennessee
stories.summary: According to Nick Triantafellou, director of marketing for Weigel's, the store is set to open in March 2027 at 4150 Cloud Springs Road in Ringgold, Georgia.

stories.title: Gone fishin': Bass tournament Friday to honor late Sheriff Tom Spangler
stories.summary: Spangler died in September. He loved fishing and once pursued a career as a professional angler.

stories.title: KPD: Knoxville teen facing 3 counts of attempted first-degree murder after driving into group in Home Depot parking lot
stories.summary: An 18-year-old in Knoxville faces three counts of attempted first-degree murder, as police say he tried to hit three people with his car, hospitalizing one.

stories.title: TVA awards $1.5M to 334 schools across the Tennessee Valley region for STEM projects
stories.summary: The program received over 700 applications and 334 were selected for funding.
